Available as intramuscular or intravenous injection only

important_note: Vasopressin is NOT available as an oral tablet or capsule formulation in the United States. All US-approved formulations are injectable solutions (IM/IV). No pill physical characteristics exist for this medication as it is not produced in solid oral dosage forms.
